rules.name: Team immunity win
rules.note: Every castaway on the winning team scores.

rules.name: Find idol / advantage
rules.note: 1 if it needs activating (2 if ready to use) pre-merge.

rules.name: Activate idol / advantage
rules.note: May land in a later episode than the find.

rules.name: Idol play saves a player
rules.note: Also counts when saving an intended ally. Judgment note recommended.

rules.name: Shot in the Dark
rules.note: 1 to play it; 5 more if it saves you (6 total).

rules.name: Manual adjustment
rules.note: Signed value with a required note. Covers bonuses and penalties such as: says the episode title +2, quit −5, medical evacuation −2, voted out holding an idol −2, given an idol +1, votes received −1 each.
